env.ours: x3d.threejs reader (shared with the Babylon bridge) + three.js body, bundle sha 8f93bd6b3684

scope: the data outputs are filled once per frame while the node is active (the test rig draws about 3 frames per second in our reader); the window is the last fftSize samples at that moment, so single samples are not compared between the engines, only rms, frequency and the peak bin; smoothingTimeConstant is read back from the audio node, not measured as a time response; the noise floor of the spectrum (bins away from the peak) is not compared
